scope: Week 2 draft: every footprint with a specific use label (not bare D/S/F), plus fuel, oil and boiler/engine rooms. Plain dwellings, stores and unlabeled sheds are not listed. Groups of identical footprints (e.g. a row of KILNs) are one entry with the count in notes.

buildings.label: OPEN KILN(S)
buildings.notes: Sanders Press Brick Co. 3 open kilns, 28' each; '5402' printed on Bischoff Ave margin

buildings.label: ENG. 40 HP, BRICK FL'R / BRICK MACH. & GRIND'G 1ST & SCREENS 2ND
buildings.notes: Sanders Press Brick Co. IR. CH. 34' AB. RF.; W.T. (water tank) 12' beside it. Boiler: fuel coal (sheet note)

buildings.label: CLAY MINE
buildings.notes: Sanders Press Brick Co. TRAMWAY both sides. A mined-out clay shaft: subsidence/fill question rather than chemical contamination

buildings.label: BL. SM. / EARTH FLOOR / HOISTING MACH.
buildings.notes: Sanders Press Brick Co. IR. CH. 24' AB. RF. Metalworking

notes: Sanders Press Brick Co. at Bischoff & Macklind, in the middle of today's Hill. Sheet note: night and Sunday watchman, small steam pump, heat stove in office, lights lanterns, fuel coal, brick floor in boiler rooms. Two crossed (stable) buildings in the yard are not listed. A POND on sheet 14 just north (Wilson/Bischoff) may be a flooded clay pit.
